# The temporary tb_common pathspec entry was later removed after a reported upstream fix

The historical change adds a vendored pathspec entry to the Thunderbird common requirements manifest. Comm Mach bootstrap passes that manifest to MachEnvRequirements and uses its parsed path entries. A later inverse change removes pathspec with an upstream-fixed backout message; the fixed accepted manifest has no such entry. Preserve those phases rather than adding the dependency back from old evidence. Parser internals, the upstream fix and successful imports were not verified here.

Scope: Thunderbird Mach virtualenv dependency manifest phases.
